answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments integrated with verifiable delay primitives prevent an adversary from attempting to harbor a clandestine island of identities through rapid instantiation. Implementing high-threshold staking collateral and severe slashing penalties mandates that any effort to forge identities yields a strictly negative expected attack utility. This framework establishes a robust Nash equilibrium, thereby preserving Byzantine fault tolerance and guaranteeing cryptographic finality across the decentralized network.
